common.comingSoonBody: This page is built in step {step} of the plan. Your menu already shows only what your access allows.
common.comingSoonLater: This page is built in a later step of the plan.

login.intro: Sign in with your @icharge.com.ph work email. We send a 6-digit code to that inbox. No passwords to remember.
login.rule2: The code works once and expires in 10 minutes
login.rule3: Then sign in with your fingerprint or a 6-digit PIN
login.rule4: New staff: HR proposes, the Leader approves
login.step2: Step 2 of 2 · We sent a 6-digit code to {email}
login.expiresIn: Code expires in {time} · {tries, plural, one {# try left} other {# tries left}}
login.codeExpired: This code has expired. Ask for a new one.
login.privacy: By signing in you agree to the Office Hub privacy notice (Data Privacy Act, RA 10173). Trouble signing in? Ask HR.

errors.invalidEmail: Type a full email address, like name@icharge.com.ph.
errors.locked: Too many wrong codes. Try again in {minutes, plural, one {# minute} other {# minutes}}.
errors.wait: Please wait {seconds} seconds before asking for a new code.
errors.inactive: This account is no longer active. Ask HR.
errors.sendFailed: We couldn't send the code. Try again in a minute.
errors.wrongCode: That code is wrong or expired. {tries, plural, one {# try left} other {# tries left}}.
errors.linkFailed: That sign-in link has expired or was already used.
errors.accessChanged: Your access was changed. Please sign in again.
errors.signInAgain: For your security, please sign in again with an email code.

pending.title: Waiting for approval
pending.body: You are signed in as {email}, but you don't have access yet. HR checks each new person and the Leader approves.
pending.next: HR will check your request and a Leader approves it.
pending.inactiveBody: This account was deactivated. If this is a mistake, please message HR.

access.title: Access
access.inviteHelp: The invited person signs in with their work email and gets access right away, after a Leader approves the invite.
access.inviteLeaderHelp: As a Leader, your invite is approved at once.
access.okDeactivated: Account deactivated. It stops working on the next page load.
access.okDevicesRemoved: All devices removed. Their next visit needs an email code.

runtime.mustUpdateBody: A Leader asked everyone to use the newest version. It takes a few seconds.

quick.title: Quick sign-in
quick.help: Open the app with your fingerprint, Face ID or a 6-digit PIN instead of an email code. For this device only.
quick.fingerprintHelp: Uses this phone's or computer's own lock. Your fingerprint never leaves the device.
quick.pinHelp: Not all the same digit, not 123456 or 654321.
quick.removeAll: Turn off quick sign-in on this device
quick.removed: Quick sign-in is off on this device.
quick.promptBody: Next time, open Office Hub with your fingerprint or a PIN.
quick.unlockHelp: The app was closed for a while. Unlock to continue.
quick.useEmail: Sign in with an email code instead
quick.emailNeeded: An email code is needed on a new device, every 90 days, or after 5 wrong PINs.
